latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of video-editor-list — organize and edit video clips with fast cloud rendering.

- Upload and organize MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM clips (up to 500MB each)
- Runs AI-powered editing in 30–60 seconds on cloud GPUs; outputs 1080p MP4
- Automatic token setup for new users, with 100 free credits and 7-day expiry
- Supports cutting, silence trimming, text overlays, and BGM via chat instructions
- Export, credits, and session state management included
- Simple workflow: upload → describe edits → download finished video
